scripts.text:
[William]
Welcome to
MacMillan's ^3355FFPost^000000 Workshop.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
欢迎光临
麦克米兰^3355FF邮政^000000工坊。

scripts.text:
[William]
My family, the MacMillan Clan, has been producing Professional Traffic Signal Posts for more than 250 years. Nowadays, we are booking Special Orders for our unique ornament, ^3355FFStop Post^000000.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
我的家族，麦克米兰一族，已经生产专业交通信号灯柱超过250年了。如今，我们正在接受我们独特饰品的特别订单，^3355FF停止标志头饰^000000。

scripts.text: Could I order one ^3355FFStop Post^000000?
scripts.translation: 我可以订购一个^3355FF停止标志头饰^000000吗？

scripts.text: Nah...
scripts.translation: 不了...

scripts.text:
[William]
This unique ornament, ^3355FFStop Post^000000, is a traffic signal on the road, and doubles as a hair ornament! This, we solemnly promise on the strength of a 100-year guarantee.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
这款独特的饰品，^3355FF停止标志头饰^000000，既是路上的交通信号灯，又是一款发饰！我们郑重承诺，提供100年保修。

scripts.text:
[William]
To produce a ^3355FFStop Post^000000, we need ^3355FF91100 Zeny^000000, ^3355FF50 Trunk^000000 and ^3355FF1 Black Dyestuffs^000000.

[William]
Here you are~!
This ^3355FFStop Post^000000 has
been especially made
just for you!
Thank you for stopping by!
...Get the joke?
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
给您~！
这个^3355FF停止标志头饰^000000
是专门为您
特别制作的！
感谢您的光临！
...懂这个梗吗？

scripts.text:
[William]
So...
When you get those items, swing on by and we'll give you a Stop Post.
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
那么...
当您准备好那些材料后，随时过来，我们会给您一个停止标志头饰。

scripts.text:
[William]
Anyway, thank you for coming by 'MacMillan's Workshop.' But think about buying something next time, will ya?
scripts.translation:
[威廉]
总之，感谢您光临“麦克米兰工坊”。不过下次请考虑买点什么，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Howdy, new customer!!
I know what you're gonna talk about. You want the Magic Glasses from me, riiiiight?
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
嘿，新顾客！！
我知道你要说什么。你是想从我这里买魔法眼镜，对吧？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Manufacture
scripts.translation: 制造

scripts.text: Ignore him
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Hmm~!
Well, the official name for them is ^3355FFBinoculars^000000! An optical device that works like a pair of field glasses, they're designed for simultaneous use by both eyes!
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
嗯~！
它们的正式名称是^3355FF望远镜^000000！这是一种像双筒望远镜一样的光学设备，设计用于双眼同时使用！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
They're made up of two small telescopes joined with a single focusing device. You can arrange the lenses to produce stereoscopic vision.
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
它由两个小望远镜和一个单一的调焦装置组成。你可以调整镜片以产生立体视觉。

scripts.text:
[Marius]
So?
Ain't that
something, huh?
Muhahahahahaha!
. . . . .
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
怎么样？
是不是很
厉害，对吧？
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
. . . . .

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Hm? You don't seem to
believe what I just said?
Oh c'mon, jerk. It's real!!
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
嗯？你似乎
不相信我刚才说的话？
拜托，混蛋。这是真的！！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
I will let you
know the items I need...
1 ^3355FFGeek Glasses^000000! 100 ^3355FFSteel^000000!
And ^3355FF50000 Zeny^000000!

[Marius]
Perfect, perfect !
Now my masterpiece will be complete!
Muhahahaha !
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
完美，完美！
现在我的杰作就要完成了！
穆哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Here you are!
Binoculars !
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
给您！
望远镜！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Just remember...
Don't peep at something you shouldn't look at. Well, at least try not to.
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
记住...
不要窥视你不该看的东西。好吧，至少试着别这么做。

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Argggghhhhhhh!!
You didn't bring
enough items!!!!
How dare you
disgrace me!!!
Baaaadddd !!
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
阿格格格格格！！
你带来的材料
不够！！！！
你竟敢
让我丢脸！！！
坏蛋！！！

scripts.text:
[Marius]
Hey you~!
Now you're in front of Marius, an Alchemist among Alchemists. Ignoring me, eh? Come on, I'll beat your ass!
scripts.translation:
[马里乌斯]
嘿，你~！
现在你站在马里乌斯面前了，我可是炼金术士中的炼金术士。无视我，是吧？来吧，我要揍扁你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but may I ask
you a question?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，请问可以问你一个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Eh? Oh, I'm sorry, I was
so busy reading this book!
So, uh, what exactly did
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
啊？哦，对不起，我刚才
太专心看这本书了！
那么，呃，你具体想问什么？

scripts.text: What are you reading?
scripts.translation: 你在看什么书？

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Ah! This is one of the best sellers of Joshua Vansei's.
The main character is a writer, and it's so touching that this guy writes a story of his mistress...
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
啊！这是约书亚·范赛的最新畅销书之一。
主角是个作家，故事非常感人，他写了自己与蜂后的故事...

scripts.text:
[Yunia]
Oh.. I can't wait to see Hoein Special..
And this, you could have a look if you want to.
scripts.translation:
[尤妮娅]
哦...我迫不及待想看看《赫因特辑》了。
还有这本，如果你感兴趣的话可以看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, now, I shouldn't.
Looks like the cover's rounded with a red strap,
which..I really think is for adults only.
ex..cuse me~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，现在，我不该看的。
看起来封面是用红色丝带绑着的，这...我觉得那是成人专用的。
对...对不起~！

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
I've always believed in Satan..
Haah... Guess it's good to be living, after all.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
我一直相信魔王...
唉...看来活着还是好的。

scripts.text:
[Sephit]
Who would've thought to actually see the Satan while alive.....?
scripts.translation:
[塞菲特]
谁能想到在活着的时候真的看到了魔王呢.....？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Oh, the world.. the world is doomed..
-sobbing-
Nothing seems to be working now..
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哦，世界...世界要毁灭了..
-哭泣-
现在似乎什么都行不通了..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....Tsk..tsk...
Good heavens.. I can't believe this young girl's drinking with sadness....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
....啧..啧...
天哪..我简直不敢相信这个年轻女孩在悲伤中喝酒....

[Continental Guard]
No commoners are allowed in the area beyond this point.
This place is extremely dangerous so you are restricted from entering.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
平民不得进入此区域。
这里极其危险，因此禁止进入。

scripts.text: Cancel Conversation
scripts.translation: 取消对话

scripts.text: Ask What Happened
scripts.translation: 询问发生了什么

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Didn't you know? Satan Morocc has resurrected and broke out of Morocc Village where he was confined.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
你不知道吗？魔王梦罗克复活了，并打破了将他囚禁的梦罗克村庄。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
His resurrection has caused irreparable damage to the village and to the desert around it, and now he has moved to the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
他的复活给村庄和周围的沙漠造成了无法弥补的破坏，现在他已转移到苏克拉特沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We are here to carry out the orders of the Prontera Kingdom by preventing commoners, aside from the members of the Morocc Subjugation, from accessing the area.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
我们在此执行普隆德拉王国的命令，阻止平民（梦罗克镇压小组成员除外）进入该区域。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
If you'd like to know more information, I suggest that you speak to the Continental Guard in charge of the accident site in Morocc Village.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
如果您想了解更多资讯，建议您与负责梦罗克村庄事故现场的大陆卫兵对话。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Ask About Guard's Location
scripts.translation: 询问卫兵的位置

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
The guard that you want to talk to is at a camp built in the center of Morocc Village.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
您想交谈的卫兵在梦罗克村庄中心搭建的营地。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
If you'd like, I can send you there directly.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
如果您愿意，我可以直接送您去那里。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text: Please do.
scripts.translation: 请这样做。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
I see. Well then, for your safety, please leave this dangerous area as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
明白了。那么，为了您的安全，请尽快离开这个危险区域。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Great. I'll send you to Morocc Village's accident site shortly.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
好的。我马上送您去梦罗克村庄的事故现场。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Welcome, members of the Continental Guards. I have a special order from Chief Balrog for you, so let me read it for you.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
欢迎，大陆卫队的成员们。我有一封来自首领巴洛格的特别命令，让我为您宣读一下。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
'Due to the dangers of this area, I hereby prohibit members of the Continental Guard to investigate the area alone. You must organize a party of at least 2 members to carry out your missions from now on.'
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
“鉴于该区域的危险性，我在此禁止大陆卫队成员单独调查该区域。从现在起，你们必须组建至少2名成员的队伍来执行任务。”

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
...You understand that, right? Please go back to the site, and come back in a party of at least 2 members. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Only members of the Continental Guards with Continental Guard Certificates are allowed to proceed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
只有持有大陆卫队证书的大陆卫队成员才能通过此处。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We've received orders from Headquarters to block access to this area since an unusual space-time phenomenon has been detected from the Morocc field.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
我们收到总部的命令，由于在梦罗克野外检测到异常时空现象，封锁了该区域的入口。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We need to wait until the phenomenon is over, and then we'll let you proceed with your investigation.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
我们需要等待现象结束，然后才会允许您继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Great. I'll send you to Morocc Village's accident site shortly.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
好的。我马上送您去梦罗克村庄的事故现场。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

啊，您是受雇于大陆卫队的冒险者。很高兴见到您。如果您需要帮助，请随时问我。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Good day, {0}. We don't have the luxury of time in this dire situation so I'll try to make this quick.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
您好，{0}。在这种危急情况下，我们没有太多时间，所以我尽量长话短说。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
I'm a messenger dispatched here to {0} from the Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters. My duty is to deliver this important message to as many renowned adventurers as I can. I'm glad that I was finally able to find you, {1}.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
我是从梦罗克大陆卫队总部派往{0}的信使。我的职责是将这份重要消息传达给尽可能多的知名冒险者。很高兴我终于找到了您，{1}。

scripts.text: Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters?
scripts.translation: 梦罗克大陆卫队总部？

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Time's running out, so I can only give you a brief explanation.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
时间紧迫，我只能简单说明一下情况。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Satan Morocc, the heinous demon imprisoned deep in Morocc's underground for centuries, has resurrected and broken free.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
被囚禁在梦罗克地下深处的魔王梦罗克，已经复活并挣脱了封印。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The revival of Satan Morocc has completely devastated Morocc Village and the area surrounding it.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
魔王梦罗克的复活，彻底摧毁了梦罗克村庄及其周边地区。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
All of the death and suffering... Anywhere else must seem like heaven compared to what's happening in and around Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
死亡与痛苦蔓延...与梦罗克发生的一切相比，其他地方简直如同天堂。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The Morocc Continental Guard was immediately organized to fight Satan Morocc and bring relief to this dire situation. I'm here to inform everyone in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom about this catastrophe.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
梦罗克大陆卫队已迅速组建，以对抗魔王梦罗克并缓解这一危急局势。我在此是为了向卢恩·米德加兹王国的所有人通报这场灾难。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
We need your help, {0}. We need reputable adventurers like you to seal away Satan Morocc once again.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
我们需要您的帮助，{0}。我们需要像您这样声誉卓著的冒险者，再次将魔王梦罗克封印起来。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
For more information, please speak to the captain of the Morocc Continental Guard. He is waiting for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
如需了解更多详情，请与梦罗克大陆卫队的船长对话。他正在等您，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The Continental Guard Headquarters is located near the center palace of Morocc, so please go speak to the chief as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
大陆卫队总部位于梦罗克中央宫殿附近，请尽快去与首领对话。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
I'm a messenger from the Morocc Continental Guards Headquarters, and I've come here to {0} with an urgent message for everyone here in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
我是梦罗克大陆卫队总部的信使，我带着紧急消息来到{0}，要传达给卢恩·米德加兹王国的所有人。

scripts.text: Morocc Continental Guard Headquarters?
scripts.translation: 梦罗克大陆卫队总部？

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Time's running out, so I can only give you a brief explanation.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
时间紧迫，我只能简单说明一下情况。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Satan Morocc, the heinous demon imprisoned deep in Morocc's underground for centuries, has resurrected and broken free.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
被囚禁在梦罗克地下深处的魔王梦罗克，已经复活并挣脱了封印。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The revival of Satan Morocc has completely devastated Morocc Village and the area surrounding it.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
魔王梦罗克的复活，彻底摧毁了梦罗克村庄及其周边地区。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
All of the death and suffering... Anywhere else must seem like heaven compared to what's happening in and around Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
死亡与痛苦蔓延...与梦罗克发生的一切相比，其他地方简直如同天堂。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The Morocc Continental Guard was immediately organized to fight Satan Morocc and bring relief to this dire situation. I'm here to inform everyone in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom about this catastrophe.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
梦罗克大陆卫队已迅速组建，以对抗魔王梦罗克并缓解这一危急局势。我在此是为了向卢恩·米德加兹王国的所有人通报这场灾难。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Part of my duty is to help recruit adventurers from around the world to help drive Satan Morocc back into confinement. It won't be easy, but he was defeated once before. Satan Morocc can be sealed away again.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
我的职责之一是招募世界各地的冒险者，协助将魔王梦罗克重新封印。这并不容易，但他曾被击败过。魔王梦罗克是可以再次被封印的。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
At least 70% of Morocc Village was destroyed by the fallout of Satan Morocc's resurrection.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
梦罗克村庄至少有70%的区域因魔王梦罗克的复活而遭到破坏。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The desert around Morocc has also turned into a land of death after it was claimed by Satan Morocc and his powerful doppelgangers and underlings.
So heed my warning, stay away from the Morocc area unless you're on a mission organized by the Morocc Continental Guard.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
梦罗克周边的沙漠也因魔王梦罗克及其强大的分身和手下而变成了死亡之地。
因此请听从我的警告，除非是执行梦罗克大陆卫队组织的任务，否则请远离梦罗克地区。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
Are you... {0}?
Ah, very well. I have an extremely important message for you.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
您是...{0}？
啊，很好。我有一条极其重要的消息要告诉您。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Messenger]
The situation is urgent, so please listen to me carefully.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队信使]
情况紧急，请仔细听我说。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
On behalf of the Continental Guard, I thank you for your efforts. Now, let me see if I've received any news from Headquarters that you should know...
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
代表大陆卫队，感谢您的付出。现在，让我看看是否收到了您应该知道的总部消息...

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Nothing yet. Please carry on with your current mission. Once again, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
还没有消息。请继续执行您当前的任务。再次感谢您。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Welcome to the Morocc Subjugation Information Center. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
欢迎来到梦罗克讨伐资讯中心。有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: What is this place for?
scripts.translation: 这是什么地方？

scripts.text: I'm here to volunteer.
scripts.translation: 我要报名志愿军。

scripts.text: Tell me about the village situation.
scripts.translation: 告诉我村庄的情况。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I'm stationed here to assist adventurers who wish to volunteer and help the Continental Guard fight Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
我驻守在此，协助那些希望志愿加入大陆卫队，共同对抗魔王梦罗克的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I am sure you are already aware that Satan Morocc's revival threatens the peace of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom, and if Satan Morocc is allowed to roam free, it will devour the entire world.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
我想您应该已经知道，魔王梦罗克的复活威胁着卢恩·米德加兹王国的和平。如果任由魔王梦罗克肆虐，它将吞噬整个世界。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
The Continental Guard is currently planning an array of countermeasures to suppress Satan Morocc under the order of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
大陆卫队目前正在王国的命令下，制定一系列对策以镇压魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
If you have been invited by our messenger, or are confident in your skills, we encourage you to volunteer for the Continental Guards and bring peace back to this continent.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
如果您收到了我们信使的邀请，或者对自己的实力有信心，我们鼓励您志愿加入大陆卫队，为这片大陆带来和平。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Welcome, {0}. I've been waiting for you. I assume our messenger informed you of our situation.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
欢迎，{0}。我一直在等您。我想我们的信使已经向您说明了当前的情况。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Let me process your application immediately. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
让我立即为您办理申请手续。请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Now please go speak to Chief Balrog of the Continental Guard. You can find him in the center.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
现在请去与大陆卫队的首领 巴洛格对话。您可以在中央找到他。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I applaud you for your courage, but you will need more than just courage to help us.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
我钦佩您的勇气，但仅凭勇气还不足以帮助我们。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Satan Morocc is most powerful evil that exists in the mortal world. Snuffing out your life would be so trivial to him.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
魔王梦罗克是凡间最强大的邪恶存在。对您而言，结束您的生命对他来说不过是举手之劳。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
I strongly recommend that you just think about your own safety for now. When the final battle comes, I am sure that no place will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
我强烈建议您现在先考虑自己的安全。当最终决战来临时，我相信没有任何地方是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
As you can see, the situation can't be worse. The village and the surrounding area were irreparably damaged by Satan Morocc's resurrection.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
如您所见，情况已经糟糕透顶。村庄及周边地区因魔王梦罗克的复活而遭受了无法修复的破坏。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Since the kingdom has dispatched Continental Guard Messengers everywhere, many able adventurers have flocked to this place, but... I'm afraid they still might not be enough to defeat the demon.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
由于王国已向各地派遣了大陆卫队信使，许多有能力的冒险者都聚集到了这里，但...恐怕这仍然不足以击败恶魔。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Please follow our instructions, at least around this area, and stay out of danger for now.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
请遵循我们的指示，至少在这个区域内，暂时远离危险。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard Official]
Your application already has been registered. Please go speak to Chief Balrog.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫队官员]
您的申请已经登记完毕。请去与首领 巴洛格对话。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
您来得不是时候，但很高兴见到您。我是大陆卫队的首领 巴洛格。我们被派往梦罗克以镇压魔王梦罗克...我们需要聚集所有能找到的力量和运气。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm sorry, but I'm too busy checking through all these applications for future Continental Guards to greet you adventurers one by one.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
抱歉，我正忙着审核这些未来大陆卫队的申请，没空逐一问候各位冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Listen, it might be more helpful if you talk to some other people first. I'm sure one of the other Continental Guards or our messengers will be better equipped to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
听着，也许先和其他人聊聊会更有帮助。我相信其他大陆卫队成员或我们的信使能更好地为您提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You've come here at a bad time, but it's nice to meet you. I'm Continental Guard Chief Balrog. We've been dispatched to Morocc in order to suppress Satan Morocc... We'll need all the strength and luck we can gather.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
您来得不是时候，但很高兴见到您。我是大陆卫队的首领 巴洛格。我们被派往梦罗克以镇压魔王梦罗克...我们需要聚集所有能找到的力量和运气。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
It looks like you have business with me. Please make it brief since I don't have a lot of time on my hands. There's lots of things I need to take care of...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
看来您有正事找我。请长话短说，因为我手头有很多事情要处理，时间很紧...

scripts.text: Ask about Continental Guards
scripts.translation: 询问关于大陆卫队的事

scripts.text: I want to join the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation: 我想加入大陆卫队

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The damage that Satan Morocc's resurrection has caused is obvious just by taking a look around this area.
What's scary is that all this was caused just by breaking out from it's prison. Just think of the damage it could do if it was left to roam around freely...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
魔王梦罗克复活所造成的破坏，只要看看周围的环境就一目了然。
可怕的是，这一切仅仅是因为它挣脱了牢笼。想象一下，如果它被放任自由地四处游荡，会造成多大的破坏...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Morocc Village is completely devastated, and Satan Morocc has now claimed possession of the Sograt Desert.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
梦罗克村庄已经彻底被毁，而魔王梦罗克现在占据了苏克拉特沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I've no doubt that if left unchecked, Satan Morocc will take over the entire Midgard Continent. We've got to stop him right now before the entire world suffers.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
毫无疑问，如果不加阻止，魔王梦罗克将占领整个米德加尔特大陆。我们必须在它给整个世界带来灾难之前，立刻阻止它。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
That's why the kingdom has ordered us elite soldiers to form the Continental Guard, and recruit reputable adventurers around the world so that we can make a united stand against Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
因此，王国命令我们精英士兵组建大陆卫队，并招募世界各地的知名冒险者，以便我们联合起来对抗魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Of course, it'll be incredibly difficult... We'll need to make sacrifices... I'm not even sure if we can win. Still, the fate of the world is at stake, and we've got to do something. Dark times have truly fallen upon us...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
当然，这将极其困难...我们将不得不做出牺牲...我甚至不确定我们能否获胜。尽管如此，世界的命运悬于一线，我们必须采取行动。黑暗的时代真的降临了...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Huh? Do you want to join us and volunteer for the Continental Guard?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
咦？你想加入我们，自愿成为大陆卫队的一员吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
What was your name? {0}? Oh yes, I've heard of you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
你叫什么名字？{0}？哦，是的，我听说过你。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Hmm, it occurs to me that you don't understand the danger involved in all this. Do you have any idea how powerful Satan Morocc is?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
嗯，我突然想到，你可能并不了解其中蕴含的危险。你知道魔王梦罗克有多强大吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
如果你不完全了解风险，就无法帮助我们。我见过成千上万鲁莽的冒险者，自以为凭一己之力就能击败魔王梦罗克，结果白白送命。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我们面对的是决定世界未来的威胁，那些无法团队协作的傻瓜只会成为累赘，而不是助力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
很抱歉，经验不足的冒险者只会妨碍我们。希望你能理解。如果你真的想帮助我们，那么请暂时专注于提升自己的实力。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Ask Again
scripts.translation: 再问一次

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Look, I understand your enthusiasm, but you're mistaken if you think you can help us. I don't have time to fully explain the danger that we're all facing.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
听着，我理解你的热情，但如果你认为你能帮上忙，那就大错特错了。我没有时间详细解释我们所有人面临的危险。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Satan Morocc is nothing like the monsters you may have encountered. At best you'll throw your life away, but there's the chance that you might get one of my men killed by your mistakes and incompetence. I can't have that!
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
魔王梦罗克与你可能遇到的魔物完全不同。最好的情况是你白白送命，但更糟糕的是，你的失误和无能可能会导致我的部下丧命。我不能让这种事发生！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Please understand that this is for your own good. Fight some Porings or whatever else might be a good match for your level.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
请理解，这是为你好。去和波利或其他适合你等级的魔物战斗吧。

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: You've just got to let me join!
scripts.translation: 你就让我加入吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Sigh... Why are you so persistent? Can't you understand that no means no? Let me say this one more time.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
唉...你为什么这么执着？难道不明白“不”就是“不”吗？让我再说最后一次。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
We're too busy fighting Satan Morocc to watch after rookies like you. You'd just be throwing your life away.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我们正忙着对抗魔王梦罗克，没空照顾像你这样的新人。你只会白白送命。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Stop bothering me. You'd be nothing but a burden.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
别烦我了。你只会成为累赘。

scripts.text: Give Up
scripts.translation: 放弃

scripts.text: Give me a chance to prove myself!
scripts.translation: 给我一个证明自己的机会！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Huh? You want a chance to prove yourself?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
哈？你想证明自己的实力？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll do whatever it takes to join the Continental Guard!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，为了加入大陆卫兵，我愿意付出任何代价！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Interesting. You have my attention. Alright, I guess it's only fair that I acknowledge your strength if you can handle something for me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
有意思。你引起了我的注意。好吧，既然你如此坚持，如果你能帮我完成一件事，我就承认你的实力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The Continental Guard has been on full alert around this village and the desert. We need to be prepared in case Satan Morocc storms our defenses.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
大陆卫兵在这个村庄和沙漠周围处于全面警戒状态。我们需要做好准备，以防魔王梦罗克突袭我们的防线。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Soldiers need firewood to keep the bonfires burning all night, but we've been suffering a firewood shortage.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
士兵们需要柴火来整夜燃烧篝火，但我们一直面临柴火短缺的问题。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I happened to hear that the monsters in the Lava Dungeon have everlasting flame which would solve our bonfire problems. I want you to gather those flames for us.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我听说熔岩副本里的魔物拥有永恒之火，这能解决我们的篝火问题。我要你去为我们收集那些火焰。

scripts.text: That's too hard! Let me think about it!
scripts.translation: 太难了！让我考虑一下！

scripts.text: No problem.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Hmpf, I was right. I knew you wouldn't be able to handle such a simple task. I shouldn't have wasted my time with you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
哼，我就知道。我早就知道连这么简单的任务你都做不了。我不该在你身上浪费时间。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Excellent! Bring back ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000. I'll be waiting for your return.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
很好！带回来^0000FF30火种^000000。我会在这里等你回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
What? How can you even think of joining us when you don't have any real skills to offer?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
什么？你没有任何实际技能，怎么敢想加入我们？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I guarantee that you'd just drag my soldiers down with you. You'd only be a threat to Satan Morocc in your dreams. Just give it up.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我敢保证，你只会拖累我的士兵。你只能在梦里威胁魔王梦罗克。还是放弃吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You won't be able to help us if you don't fully understand the risks. I've seen thousands of foolhardy adventurers throw their lives away by thinking they could defeat Satan Morocc with their own strength.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
如果你不完全了解风险，就无法帮助我们。我见过成千上万鲁莽的冒险者，自以为凭一己之力就能击败魔王梦罗克，结果白白送命。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
We are facing a threat that will determine the world's future, and fools that can't work in a team will be liabilities, not assets.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我们面对的是决定世界未来的威胁，那些无法团队协作的傻瓜只会成为累赘，而不是助力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm sorry, but inexperienced adventurers would just get in our way. I hope you understand. If you really want to help us, then please focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
很抱歉，经验不足的冒险者只会妨碍我们。希望你能理解。如果你真的想帮助我们，那么请暂时专注于提升自己的实力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
So, did you find ^0000FF30 Live Coals^000000? You didn't come empty-handed, did you?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
那么，你找到^0000FF30火种^000000了吗？你不会空手而归吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Let's see... One, two, three... Thirty, you've brought them all. Well, this was a pretty simple task. All it takes is time and a little effort. Anyone could do it.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
让我看看...一，二，三...三十，你都带回来了。嗯，这确实是个简单的任务。只需要一点时间和努力。谁都能做到。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Anyways, thank you for bringing the Live Coals. I guess you're stronger than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
总之，谢谢你带回了火种。看来你比我想象的更强。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now will you let me join the Continental Guard?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在你可以让我加入大陆卫兵了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
No, gathering these flames is a piece of cake compared to what we're going to do.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
不，收集这些火焰与我们即将要做的事情相比，简直是小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm still not convinced that you're good enough to join us. Let me think... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我仍然不确信你有足够的实力加入我们。让我想想... 嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't think you would accept me so easily. I'm ready. Ask me whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没想到你会这么轻易地接受我。我准备好了。尽管问吧，问什么都行。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Ah, I've got an idea. Now, because this is an allied operation, we've accepted some mercenary soldiers from the Schwarzwald Republic to join the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
啊，我有个主意。既然这是一次联合行动，我们接纳了一些来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的佣兵加入大陆卫兵。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
These mercenaries have never seen the desert, and they're having trouble carrying out operations in the heat, dry air, and sandstorms. It's not their fault, but they could use a little help since they're out of their element.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
这些佣兵从未见过沙漠，他们在炎热、干燥的空气和沙尘暴中执行任务时遇到了困难。这不是他们的错，但他们身处陌生环境，可能需要一点帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(This guy seems threatening, but he seems to have a good heart.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(这家伙看起来很有威胁性，但他似乎心地善良。)

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Now, I remember hearing that the monsters in the Ice Cave to the north have frozen hearts. Those hearts might be able to relieve those soldiers from the heat.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我记得听说北边的冰洞里的魔物拥有冰封之心。那些心脏或许能缓解那些士兵的炎热。

scripts.text: That's too hard!
scripts.translation: 太难了！

scripts.text: No problem. How many do you want?
scripts.translation: 没问题。你要多少？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I knew that'd be too tough for you. I'm glad you finally realized your limits before it was too late. It takes wisdom to recognize your weakness.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我就知道这对你来说太难了。很高兴你在为时已晚之前意识到了自己的极限。能认识到自己的弱点是一种智慧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You'd better pack up and return where you came from. You want to be far away from here when Satan Morocc attacks.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
你最好收拾好行囊，回到你来的地方。当魔王梦罗克进攻时，你最好离这里远远的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Huh?! Are you sure you can bring those? Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
什么？！你确定你能带回来吗？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Well... If you insist on giving it a try, then... I'll need at least 50 of those frozen hearts.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
好吧... 如果你坚持要试试的话... 我至少需要50个冰封之心。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Please bring me ^0000FF50 Glacial Hearts^000000. The faster you get them here, the better.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
请给我带^0000FF50冰块心脏^000000。越快越好。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 30 Live Coals, 30.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
嗯... 你没听到我说的话吗？我说的是30个火种，30个。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
现在快点去吧。如果你想放弃，没关系。但请告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
So, did you find 50 Glacial Hearts?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
那么，你找到50个冰块心脏了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Thank you. I'm sure that my soldiers will appreciate these... Those guys aren't used to the desert, and could use the relief.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
谢谢。我相信我的士兵们会感激这些... 那些家伙不习惯沙漠，需要这些来缓解炎热。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Well... It looks like you earned this.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
嗯... 看来你确实赢得了这个。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是什么？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You'd know if you read it. It's a certificate that proves that you're a member of the Continental Guard. I admit that I'm impressed by your skills and gumption.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
如果你读一下就会知道。这是一张证明你是大陆卫兵成员的证书。我承认，你的技能和勇气让我印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Welcome to the Continental Guard, my friend. Are you ready to risk your life for the sake of peace in the world?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
欢迎加入大陆卫兵，我的朋友。
你准备好为了世界的和平而献出生命了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Your mission from here on will be simple, but extremely difficult: you will join the rest of the Continental Guard to keep Satan Morocc from fully reviving its true power.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
从今以后，你的任务很简单，但极其困难：
你将加入大陆卫兵，阻止魔王梦罗克完全恢复其真正的力量。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
My soldiers are risking their lives to fight Morocc's doppelgangers and underlings in order to make it safer for their comrades to travel to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我的士兵们正冒着生命危险，
与梦罗克的分身和手下战斗，
以便让他们的同志能更安全地前往梦罗克的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
It looks like your help could be useful after all. It's time for you to pitch in. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
看来你的帮助确实派上用场了。
是时候让你大显身手了。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Umm... Didn't you hear what I said? I said 50 Glacial Hearts, 50.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
嗯... 你没听到我说的话吗？
我说的是50个冰块心脏，50个。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Now hurry up. If you feel like giving up, it's no problem. Let me know, though!
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
现在快点去吧。如果你想放弃，没关系。但请告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I guess you'd benefit from a full situational briefing. Shall I brief you now?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
看来你需要一份完整的情报简报。
现在为你简报吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I'm going to tell you some basic information about fighting Satan Morocc as a member of the Continental Guard.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我将向你介绍作为大陆卫兵成员，
对抗魔王梦罗克的一些基本信息。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Do you remember what Morocc was like before this happened? You would if you've been here before.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
你还记得事情发生前梦罗克的样子吗？
如果你之前来过这里，应该记得。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Right now, all of Morocc's entrances and the outer fields leading to other villages are currently under our control.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
目前，梦罗克的所有入口以及通往其他村庄的外围区域，
都在我们的控制之下。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The main reason for this is because Satan Morocc has been sighted in Sograt Desert, but there's another important reason.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
主要原因是魔王梦罗克在苏克拉特沙漠被目击到了，
但还有另一个重要原因。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Satan Morocc's power has been causing unnatural gaps in our time-space continuum. The gaps are isolated to this area for now, but we can't be sure if they'll spread.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
魔王梦罗克的力量正在我们的时空连续体中造成不自然的裂隙。
目前这些裂隙仅限于该区域，但我们无法确定它们是否会扩散。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Due to the time-space gaps, Sograt Desert's terrain has changed, and some parts of the desert have disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
由于时空裂隙，苏克拉特沙漠的地形发生了变化，
沙漠的部分区域已经消失。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Furthermore, the situation's gotten worse since Satan Morocc's doppelgangers started appearing, and other monsters have become influenced by its power.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
此外，自从魔王梦罗克的分身开始出现以来，情况变得更加糟糕，
其他魔物也受到了其力量的影响。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
That's all we know so far. If you go out, you'll see what I mean... You may even see horrors that we haven't discovered yet. If you need more information, please speak to the Continental Official.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
目前我们只知道这些。
如果你出去看看，就会明白我的意思...
你甚至可能看到我们尚未发现的恐怖景象。
如果你需要更多信息，请去对话大陆官员。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Please do your best to hold back Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands. Dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
请尽力阻止魔王梦罗克。
别忘了，大陆的未来掌握在我们手中。解散。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I see. Keep up your good work in fighting Satan Morocc. Don't forget that the future of the continent is in our hands.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
明白了。继续在对魔王梦罗克的战斗中保持出色的表现。
别忘了，大陆的未来掌握在我们手中。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Wah... What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
哇... 什么？你真的击败了魔王梦罗克？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
How? Do you have any proof of your victory?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
怎么做到的？你有胜利的证据吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
...No, I can't just accept and trust your verbal account. I mean, if you've completed such an important mission, you must bring me some evidence.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
...不，我不能仅凭你的口头陈述就接受并相信。
我是说，如果你完成了如此重要的任务，必须给我一些证据。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Go back, bring proof of your victory, and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
回去，带上你胜利的证据，然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
What? Did you really defeat Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
什么？你真的击败了魔王梦罗克？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
How? Do you have any proof of your victory?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
怎么做到的？你有胜利的证据吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Is... Isn't this?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
这...这不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Wow... I think this is really the skin of Satan Morocc. Congratulations, soldier. You just saved this world and people from being consumed by destruction and evil.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
哇...我想这确实是魔王梦罗克的皮。
恭喜你，士兵。你刚刚拯救了这个世界和人民，使他们免于被毁灭和邪恶吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I guess you seriously wounded Satan Morocc, and it retreated to a time-space gap. No doubt it's trying to recoup its strength.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
看来你严重击伤了魔王梦罗克，它撤退到了时空裂隙中。
毫无疑问，它正在试图恢复力量。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
My only regret is that we can't pursue Morocc beyond this dimension. I'm glad, however, that you defeated Satan Morocc and kept it from regaining its full strength. For now, anyway...
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我唯一的遗憾是我们无法跨越这个维度去追击梦罗克。
不过，我很高兴你击败了魔王梦罗克，阻止了它恢复全部力量。至少暂时是这样...

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Our researchers might be able to learn some important new facts from this piece of skin... We need to learn all we can about that monster if peace is to be possible in our world's future.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我们的研究员或许能从这块皮上了解到一些重要的新事实...
如果我们要在未来实现和平，就必须尽可能多地了解那个魔物。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Once again, I thank you for your distinguished service on behalf of the Continental Guard and the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. I'll report your great achievement to His Majesty right away.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
再次感谢你在大陆卫兵和卢恩·米德加兹王国服役期间的杰出表现。
我会立刻向陛下汇报你的伟大成就。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I've prepared a few things to give as a reward for you. Let's see... I have three items. Which one do you like to receive?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我准备了一些东西作为给你的奖励。
让我看看...我有三件物品。你想领取哪一件？

scripts.text: 1. Seal of Continental Guard
scripts.translation: 1. 皇家卫士的徽章

scripts.text: 2. Morocc Charm Stone
scripts.translation: 2. 梦罗克护符石

scripts.text: 3. Morocc Ring
scripts.translation: 3. 梦罗克戒指

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The Seal of Continental Guard is an extremely valuable reward given directly from the kingdom court. It is a symbol of strength.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
皇家卫士的徽章是由王国宫廷直接颁发的极其珍贵的奖励。
它是力量的象征。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The accessory's options are: ^0000FF MHP+50, +3% Attack Speed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
该饰品的选项是：^0000FF MHP+50, +3% 攻击速度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Do you really want the Seal of Continental Guard?
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
你确定要领取皇家卫士的徽章吗？

scripts.text: 1. Yes.
2. No.

[Chief Balrog]
Great, then I'll reward you with the Seal of Continental Guard. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
很好，那么我将把皇家卫士的徽章作为奖励给你。
恭喜你。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
I hope you keep in mind that our battle is far from over. Our enemy is the king of demons... I fear that Satan Morocc will return someday soon.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
我希望你记住，我们的战斗还远未结束。
我们的敌人是恶魔之王...我担心魔王梦罗克很快就会卷土重来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
Enjoy your victory, but be ever watchful and vigilant. I will always be here to help and reward you for your service.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
享受你的胜利吧，但请时刻保持警惕。
我会一直在这里，为你的服务提供帮助和奖励。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
You should go rest now. Don't worry, we'll take care of everything else here.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
你现在应该去休息了。
别担心，这里的一切我们会处理好的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
No problem. Take your time to think, and then speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
没问题。请慢慢考虑，然后再来与我对话。

scripts.text:
[Chief Balrog]
The Morocc Charm Stone is an extremely valuable reward given directly from the kingdom court, and it is a symbol of prosperity and mana.
scripts.translation:
[首领 巴洛格]
梦罗克护符石是王国宫廷直接颁发的极珍贵奖励，它象征着繁荣与魔力。

scripts.text:

The accessory's options are: ^0000FF MSP+50, -1% Casting Speed^000000.
scripts.translation:

该饰品的选项为：^0000FF MSP+50，施法速度-1%^000000。

scripts.text: ^660000Morocc, the City of the Desert, has been completely devastated by Satan Morocc.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000沙漠之城梦罗克，已被魔王梦罗克彻底摧毁。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000The people of Morocc were resilient enough to endure the region's harsh weather, but their toughness to the weather could not prepare them enough as they witnessed the destruction brought down upon the city by Satan Morocc.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000梦罗克的居民足够坚韧，能够忍受该地区恶劣的天气，但他们对天气的坚韧不足以让他们做好准备，目睹魔王梦罗克给这座城市带来的毁灭。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000This man, who looks as dry and thin as a fish dried up under the sun, still has a smile that reminds you of a benevolent god, and is touching a book in his hand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000这个看起来像被太阳晒干的鱼一样干瘦的男人，脸上仍带着让你想起仁慈神明的微笑，正抚摸着他手中的书。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Watching him makes you giggle, he looks no better than the dried corpses in the pyramid, but he is obviously alive and doesn't appear to be a monster. Somehow, you find yourself compelled to approach this interesting looking man.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000看着他让你忍不住发笑，他看起来不比金字塔里的干尸好多少，但他显然还活着，也不像是魔物。不知为何，你发现自己被这个看起来很有趣的男人吸引，想要靠近他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
Ah... Mammi...
scripts.translation:
[摸书的男子]
啊...妈妈...

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
Your healthy golden skin is glowing under the blessed sunlight of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[摸书的男子]
你健康的金色肌肤，在梦罗克神圣的阳光下闪闪发光。

scripts.text:
[Book-Touching Man]
Your smile outshines the aura of the gods of Valhalla. You are a living gospel. Your smile even makes Goddess Freya hide in the shadows in shame! Ah.... Mammi, my Mammi!
scripts.translation:
[摸书的男子]
你的笑容比英灵殿众神的光辉还要耀眼。你是一本活生生的福音书，你的笑容甚至让女神芙蕾雅都羞愧地躲进阴影里！啊……妈妈，我的妈妈！

scripts.text: ^660000You wave your hand close to his face to get his attention. He seems, however, to be in his own dreams, completely oblivious of your presense.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你在他的脸前挥了挥手，试图引起他的注意。然而，他似乎沉浸在自己的梦境中，完全没察觉到你的存在。^000000

什么？你不知道妈妈吗？她是卢恩·米德加兹三大偶像之一啊！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
- Page 1 -
Renowned Assassin Sieglinde: 'I serve you only.'
 
 Sieglinde has attained the title of Greatest Assassin
for his professionalism
and fame among ladies,
for his bad-boy image characterized by his sharpened Katar:
a handsome man that lives a life of romantic loneliness.
Recently this Assassin-Turned-Into-Celebrity has made
a true confession with a smile on his face:
he has been secretly going out with a lady,
and they are planning to wed next year.
 The lady in question is known as Priestess M,
and she works in Prontera Church, but he refused to give us more information
about his fiancee for the sake of her safety.
As soon as the news spread,
his female fans showed a negative reaction
saying, 'This is ridiculous.
Assassins must live alone under the shadows.'
Hopefully the fans' reaction won't cause too much worry
to Siglinde and his soon-to-be wife.
scripts.translation:
- 第1页 -
著名刺客西格琳德：“我只为您效劳。”

西格琳德凭借其专业素养，
以及在女士们中的名声，
还有那标志性的坏男孩形象——
手持磨得锋利的拳刃，
过着浪漫而孤独生活的英俊男子——
获得了“最强刺客”的称号。
最近，这位从刺客转型为明星的人物，
面带微笑地做出了真正的告白：
他一直在秘密地与一位女士约会，
并计划明年结婚。
这位女士被称为女祭司M，
在普隆德拉教堂工作，
但为了她的安全，他拒绝透露更多关于未婚妻的信息。
消息传出后，
他的女性粉丝反应强烈，
表示：“这太荒谬了。
刺客必须独自生活在阴影之下。”
希望粉丝们的反应不会给西格琳德
和他的准新娘带来太多担忧。

scripts.text:
- Page 4 -
Fight Scene in Juno
 
Last night, two young men were witnessed
violently fighting each other in Juno Plaza.
According to the Juno soldier that arrested them,
Mr. B had not been so happy with Mr. A's
careless behavior, and it seems
that his patience finally ran out last night.
It seems the fight started when Mr. A put his bare sweaty feet on Mr. B's thigh,
saying that his feet are too sweaty.'
Blame the hot weather, people!
scripts.translation:
- 第4页 -
朱诺的打斗场面

昨晚，两名年轻男子被目击
在朱诺广场激烈互殴。
根据逮捕他们的朱诺士兵的说法，
B先生一直对A先生
漫不经心的行为感到不满，
看来他的耐心昨晚终于耗尽了。
似乎这场架是因为A先生
把光着脚、满是汗水的脚踩在B先生的大腿上，
并说他的脚太臭而引发的。
“怪天气太热了，人们！”

scripts.text:
God's Warning: A Secret Lab Reduced to Ashes
 
 The smoke clouding the sky of Juno last night
turned out to be from
a secret laboratory set on fire.
 More information about the laboratory
has not yet been released, but according to the witnesses,
the laboratory was found empty
without anybody or anything inside
except broken pieces of test tubes
which proved that the place was used as a laboratory.
 Scientist Sion, the accident scene investigator,
suspects from the remnants of machines inside
that the laboratory must have been used
to test biotechnology projects,
and expressed his belief that the fire was the wrath of God,
righteous punishment for trifling with his creations.
scripts.translation:
神的警告：秘密实验室化为灰烬

昨晚笼罩朱诺天空的烟雾，
原来是一座秘密实验室起火所致。
关于该实验室的更多信息
尚未公布，但据目击者称，
实验室被发现时里面空无一人，
除了破碎的试管碎片，
这些碎片证明该处曾被用作实验室。
事故现场调查员、科学家西昂，
根据室内机器残骸推测，
该实验室可能用于测试生命工学研究项目，
并坚信这场火灾是神的愤怒，
是对亵渎神造物者的公正惩罚。

scripts.text: Wait, then what about the place where they escaped...?

scripts.text: What if they have any descendents or successors?

scripts.text:

You are now convinced this was not just your dream or illusion. You had a vision of what really happened in the past.

你感到心跳加速，兴奋不已。
你现在确信这不仅仅是你的梦或幻觉。你看到了过去真实发生的一切。

scripts.text:
- Culture Page -
- Please Save My Water -
 
A recently acclaimed young author,
Jean Cadoc's new series
'Please Save My Water' has been ranked at the top
for the most checked-out book in libraries.
'Please Save My Water' is about a girl called Ujer
who was blessed by Mother Nature.
Her father left a will on his deathbed
 to 'protect the water' against the evil,
and she is fighting against a group of evil villains
that are contaminating nature so that she can purify the water.
This book will be soon selected as an essential academic book of
the Schwarzwald Republic for
promoting morality and
promoting environmental protection throughout the nation.
scripts.translation:
- 文化版 -
- 请拯救我的水 -
 
最近备受赞誉的年轻作家
让·卡多克的新系列
《请拯救我的水》
在图书馆借阅率中名列前茅。
《请拯救我的水》讲述了一个名叫乌杰的女孩，
她受到了自然母亲的祝福。
她的父亲在临终前立下遗嘱，
要求她“保护水源”免受邪恶侵害，
她正在与一群污染自然、
企图让她净化水源的邪恶反派斗争。
这本书很快将被选为
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的必修学术书籍，
以促进道德修养
和全国范围内的环境保护。

scripts.text:
Einbech Mine Collapsed (2)
 
According to an employee of Rekenber Corporation,
which has been leading Einbech's mining business,
three dead bodies have been discovered,
but one survivor was admitted into a hospital.
He is in a critical condition,
and also informed us that they are
still searching for survivors,
and have hired specialists to investigate
the cause of the accident.
scripts.translation:
艾音贝赫矿难（2）
 
据负责艾音贝赫采矿业务的
雷肯贝尔公司的一名员工称，
已发现三具尸体，
但有一名幸存者被送往医院。
他伤势危重，
并告知我们他们仍在搜寻幸存者，
并聘请了专家调查
事故原因。

scripts.text:
< Since he was young - it was before he could even remember exactly how young he was - his dreams have filled his brain with immense knowledge that he had never seen or learned from anywhere else.
He was a little boy outside, but wiser than any grown sage. He spoke many languages so fluently that they sounded like Edda chanted by Odin.
To him, his small and dark underground village was a prison blocking him from satisfying his curiosity and desire for freedom.
He expressed his desire to learn more knowledge of the outside world to stepmother Eva, but she always ignored his wish with a stern look.
Eventually, her unreasonable dissuasion could no longer stop him from escaping his reality.
 
- Gasp! Gasp! -
He ran through the darkness which seemed to have no end. He was running away from everything that tried to confine him.>
scripts.translation:
< 从他年幼时起——甚至早到他无法确切记得自己有多小的时候——他的梦境就填满了他的大脑，赋予了他从未在任何地方见过或学过的渊博知识。
他在外面是个小男孩，却比任何成年的贤者都要睿智。他流利地掌握了许多语言，听起来就像奥丁吟唱的埃达一样。
对他来说，那个狭小阴暗的地下村庄是一座监狱，阻碍了他满足好奇心和追求自由的渴望。
他向继母伊娃表达了自己想要学习更多关于外部世界知识的愿望，但她总是用严厉的眼神无视他的请求。
最终，她不合理的劝阻再也无法阻止他逃离现实。
 
- 喘气！喘气！ -
他在看似没有尽头的黑暗中奔跑。他在逃离一切试图禁锢他的东西。>

scripts.text:
< - Umm...-
-...He's awake.-
- Hello, can you see me? How do you feel? -
An old man slowly walked into the room. With a smile on the face, he sat down on a chair. The little boy felt afraid for a little while after seeing people outside his village for the first time,
but then he forced himself up from the bed, and looked around.
 
- Where am I? Why am I here? - 
- I was riding a carriage last night, and found you lying in the street. My name is Haeji. You may call me Mr. Haeji, son.-
-.......-
- What's your name? -
-......Al.-
- Do you know why you're on the street? Where do you live? Your parents must be dying to see you.-
Haeji's comment instantly brought the monsterous image of Eva to Al's mind. Inwardly, he screamed in fear.
- I live nowhere, and I don't have parents. -
Al had to lie no matter how long, he thought. The old man seemed to understand him: his eyes showed sympathy for the little boy. Haeji insisted that Al could stay in his mansion as long as he wanted.
Later, after learning that Haeji was a professor of Juno City University, Al was convinced that the fates were on his side.>
scripts.translation:
< - 嗯...-
-...他醒了。-
- 你好，你能看见我吗？你感觉怎么样？ -
一位老人慢慢走进房间。他面带微笑，在椅子上坐下。小男孩第一次看到村外的人，感到有些害怕，
但随后他强迫自己从床上坐起来，环顾四周。
 
- 我在哪里？我为什么在这里？ - 
- 昨晚我坐马车时，发现你躺在街上。我叫海吉。你可以叫我海吉先生，孩子。-
-.......-
- 你叫什么名字？ -
-......阿尔。-
- 你知道自己为什么会在街上吗？你住在哪里？你的父母一定很想见你。-
海吉的话立刻让阿尔脑海中浮现出伊娃那怪物的形象。他在内心恐惧地尖叫。
- 我没有家，也没有父母。 -
无论多久，阿尔都不得不撒谎。老人似乎理解了他：他的眼神流露出对小男孩的同情。海吉坚持让阿尔可以一直住在他的大宅里。
后来，在得知海吉是朱诺城大学的智者后，阿尔确信命运站在自己这一边。>

scripts.translation: ^660000这座古老、巨大且透着几分压迫感的建筑，正从破碎敞开的窗户中冒出暗红色的烟雾。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000While trying to remember what happened, you encounter a woman who passes by you. You instinctively reach for her shoulder to get her attention.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000当你试图回忆刚才发生了什么时，一位女子从你身边经过。你本能地伸手抓住她的肩膀，试图引起她的注意。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahchoo! Ahchoo! Gosh...
Hey, where am I...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
阿嚏！阿嚏！天哪...
嘿，我在哪里...？

scripts.text: - Pzzzz -
scripts.translation: - 滋滋滋 -

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, your arm passed through her body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人惊讶的是，你的手臂直接穿过了她的身体。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Where the hell am I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我到底在鬼地方？

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Fire!
Everybody, move, move!
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
着火了！
大家，快跑，快跑！

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Cough, cough!
Argh... I can't breathe... I have to get out...
scripts.translation:
[研究员]
咳咳！
啊...我喘不过气...我必须逃出去...

scripts.text: ^660000You walked through the flame engulfed hallway and ended at a room that was about to collapse, just like everywhere else in this place.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你穿过被火焰吞噬的走廊，来到一间即将坍塌的房间，就像这里其他地方一样。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You could not clearly see what was inside the room because of all the smoke, but you knew there was something there.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000由于烟雾弥漫，你看不清房间里的情况，但你知道那里有东西。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You squinted your eyes, and listened. You could hear human voices, but their silhouettes of whomever was talking were not human shaped.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你眯起眼睛，仔细聆听。你能听到人声，但说话者的轮廓并非人形。^000000

scripts.text:
[Female]
Cough! Fire... Cough!
Goddamn humans... Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[女性]
咳！火...咳！
该死的人类...咳咳！

scripts.text: ^660000Her coughing grew worse as the roaring of the flames grew stronger.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000随着火焰的咆哮声愈发强烈，她的咳嗽也愈发剧烈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Male]
They ran away, and left us behind to die!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
他们逃走了，却把我们留在这里等死！

scripts.text:
[Female]
...Are we going to die?
scripts.translation:
[女性]
...我们要死了吗？

scripts.text:
[Male]
Die? ...Haha.
^3131FF'Eva'^000000, we won't die... We were never exactly alive to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[男性]
死？...哈哈。
^3131FF伊娃^000000，我们不会死的...我们本来就不算活着。

scripts.text: - Crumbling -
scripts.translation: - 崩塌 -

scripts.text:
[Male]
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
啊！

scripts.text: ^660000The only exit was blocked by steel bars; no one could get out of the room enveloped in flames. Then, a corner of a wall crumbled by the heat from the fire.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000唯一的出口被钢条封死，没人能逃出这间被火焰包围的房间。随后，墙壁的一角因高温而崩塌。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000The male silhouette quickly approached the wall, and started to dig at the crumbled corner.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那个男性的身影迅速靠近墙壁，开始挖掘崩塌的角落。^000000

scripts.text:
[Male]
...It's done!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
...完成了！

scripts.text:
[Male]
Let's go, Eva!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
走，伊娃！

scripts.text:
[Eva]
Wait, we have to take the children with us.
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
等等，我们要带上孩子们。

scripts.text: ^660000The female silhouette called Eva approached the test tubes standing in a row against a wall.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000那个被称为伊娃的女性身影走向靠墙排列的一排试管。^000000

scripts.text:
[Male]
Eva!! We don't have time to save all of them! Come here!
scripts.translation:
[男性]
伊娃！！没时间救所有人了！快过来！

scripts.text: ^660000Suddenly a flash of light stung your eyes. A few seconds later, you opened your eyes and found that you were somewhere in Schwarzwald.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000突然，一道强光刺痛了你的眼睛。几秒后，你睁开眼，发现自己身处修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000And you aren't alone: you can now clearly see the man and woman that escaped the laboratory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000而且你并不孤单：你现在能清楚地看到那对从实验室逃出来的男女。^000000

scripts.text:
[Grotesque Man]
Where should we go?
No one will welcome us... We look like monsters!
scripts.translation:
[面目狰狞的男子]
我们要去哪里？
没人会欢迎我们...我们看起来就像魔物！

scripts.text:
[Eva]
...
I know a cave that's hidden in the north.
We can stay there for a while.
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
...
我知道北边有个隐蔽的山洞。
我们可以先在那里待一段时间。

scripts.text: ^660000They seemed completely oblivious of your presence, and headed north.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他们似乎完全没察觉到你的存在，径直向北走去。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You were looking at their backs as they left, and then noticed that you were holding the book you were reading in your hands. Then....^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你望着他们离去的背影，然后注意到自己手里正拿着刚才在读的那本书。接着....^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You wake up, and look around you. Somehow, you've now ended up in a huge mansion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你醒来，环顾四周。不知为何，你现在身处一座巨大的宅邸中。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You suddenly feel a sharp pain in your chest, as if someone were squeezing your heart.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你突然感到胸口一阵剧痛，仿佛有人正在挤压你的心脏。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000This mansion looks very elegant and expensive, but it is on fire, just like the laboratory in your first dream.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000这座宅邸看起来非常优雅昂贵，但它正在燃烧，就像你第一个梦中的实验室一样。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You're having trouble thinking because of your chest pain and the fire, but you know that this mansion won't last long. You look around for an exit, and see a man standing downstairs in the center of flames.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000胸口的疼痛和火焰让你难以思考，但你知道这座宅邸撑不了多久。你四处寻找出口，看到楼下火焰中央站着一个男人。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000He didn't seem to care that he'd perish along with the mansion, and was talking slowly in a low, sad voice.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他似乎并不在意自己将与宅邸一同化为灰烬，只是用低沉而悲伤的声音缓慢地诉说着。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
.....................
After all, God has trifled with me...
This was his plan all long...
Even my best friends were his puppets...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
.....................
到头来，神一直在戏弄我...
这一切都是他的计划...
甚至我最亲密的朋友也是他的傀儡...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
I strongly resent my fate...
But I'm ready to accept the end... Of everything...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
我强烈地憎恨自己的命运...
但我已准备好接受终结... 一切的终结...

scripts.text: ^660000He could not finish his words before flames swallowed him up. At the same time, you were...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他没能说完话，就被火焰吞没了。与此同时，你...^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Was it a dream?
..................
...Gosh, that was strange.

[Mysterious Man]
Mother was... She was a regular human.
Was I standing next to her?
..................
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
母亲是... 她只是个普通的人类。
我刚才站在她身边吗？
..................

scripts.text: ^660000He mumbled to himself, and brushed back his sweaty hair with a trembling hand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他喃喃自语，用颤抖的手拨开满是汗水的头发。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A dream again.
I guess he won't be able to see or hear me, just like the others.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
又是梦。
看来他和其他人一样，既看不见也听不到我。

scripts.text:
^660000You put your guard down, and stare at him.
Suddenly his face distorted in anger as he looked right back at you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000你放松了警惕，凝视着他。
突然，他转过头直视着你，脸上露出愤怒的神情。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
How the hell did you find me?!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
你他妈是怎么找到我的？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Wah! He can see me! He can see me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...哇！他能看到我！他能看到我！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Woman]
You don't have to be so angry at me, sir.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的女子]
先生，您不必对我这么生气。

scripts.text:
^660000As soon as you heard her voice,
you turned around and found a woman standing there.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000听到她的声音，你转过身，发现那里站着一个女人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Woman]
It was almost done, but then you broke all of them -- even ^FF00FFBEEP^000000 and ^FF00FFBEEP^000000 -- and were hiding in here.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的女子]
本来都快完成了，结果你却把它们全毁了——连^FF00FF哔哔^000000和^FF00FF哔哔^000000都毁了——还躲在这里。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
They weren't supposed to exist in this world!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
它们本不该存在于这个世界！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Woman]
It's his decision. Your fate is on his...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的女子]
这是他的决定。你的命运掌握在他...

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Man]
Shut up!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的男子]
闭嘴！

scripts.text: ^660000The raging man drew a sword, and pointed it at her. She then suddenly transformed into a crow and flew away. The echos of her laughter could be heard outside the window.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000愤怒的男子拔出了剑，指向她。她突然变成一只乌鸦飞走了。窗外还能听到她笑声的回响。^000000

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
You are bound to your fate, no matter how hard you try to escape...
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
无论你如何试图逃避，你都注定要面对自己的命运...

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
外人不得越过此地。

scripts.text: Step back.
scripts.translation: 退后一步

scripts.text: No, listen to me!
scripts.translation: 不，请听我说！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hah, I knew you would be scared of me!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
哈，我就知道你会怕我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... Ahchoo!
'I'm not like other outsiders... Ahchoo!
I have a goal to achieve in here... Ahchoo!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...阿嚏！
我和其他外人不...阿嚏！
我有必须在这里完成的目标...阿嚏！

scripts.text: ^660000Although you a bit intimidated by this guard, and your sneezing definitely not helping, you continue.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000虽然你被这个守卫的气势吓到了，而且你的喷嚏也帮不上什么忙，但你还是继续前行。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm here to find somebody!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是来找人的！

scripts.text: Her name is ^FF0000{0}^000000!

[Cave Settler]
Are you kidding me? If you're looking for a missing child, go to the Juno police station!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你在开玩笑吗？如果你在找失踪的孩子，去朱诺警察局！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Did you just say Eva?
Hmm...
Wait here.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你刚才说的是伊娃？
嗯...
在这里等一下。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hey, Jaeda!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿，杰达！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Go upstairs, and tell Eva that she has a visitor.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
上楼去，告诉伊娃有客人来了。

scripts.text: ^660000Surprisingly, he seemed to know who Eva is. You still could not believe that she actually exists! It's all so very strange.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000令人惊讶的是，他似乎认识伊娃。你仍然不敢相信她真的存在！这一切都太奇怪了。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000You can feel the excitement and anticipation well within you. Maybe you're coming closer to learning what your dreams really mean.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你能感觉到内心涌起的兴奋与期待。也许你正逐渐接近了解你梦境的真正含义。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hmm... Yeah? I see.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嗯...是吗？我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Hey, you can pass. Go upstairs, but you'd better think twice before trying anything funny. Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
嘿，你可以过去了。上楼吧，但最好三思而后行，别耍什么花样。听懂了吗？

scripts.text:
^660000The stern-looking man examined you, and then stepped to the side, allowing you to pass.
You clenched your fists in nervousness, and then started up the dark stairwell.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000这位神情严肃的男子审视了你一番，然后让开了路，让你通过。
你紧张地握紧了拳头，然后开始走上昏暗的楼梯。^000000

[Cave Settler]
No outsiders are allowed beyond this point.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
外人不得越过此地。

scripts.text: ^660000His voice is as stern and intimidating as his appearance.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的声音和他的外表一样，严厉而令人畏惧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Do you still have business with Zid?
You'd better finish it quickly because we don't like outsiders running around our village.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你还有事要找齐德吗？
最好快点办完，我们不喜欢外人在村子里乱晃。

^660000You are looking at a man who appears as hideous as a monster.
He was the man with Eva that you saw in your dream. Of course, he's older now, and his age is showing in his face and skin.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000你正看着一个长相丑陋如魔物的男子。
他正是你在梦中与伊娃在一起时见到的那个人。当然，他现在年纪大了，岁月在他脸上和皮肤上留下了痕迹。^000000

scripts.text: (WHIZZ)

^660000The pain in your chest suddenly hits you...
And your lungs seem much weaker from all of the coughing and sneezing you've suffered lately.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660000胸口的疼痛突然袭来...
最近频繁的咳嗽和打喷嚏让你的肺部似乎更加虚弱了。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Rubbing your chest to ease the pain, you keep staring at him in surprise.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你揉着胸口试图缓解疼痛，惊讶地凝视着他。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Thankfully, he speaks to you first.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000谢天谢地，他先开口说话了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
Does my appearance bother you?
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
我的长相让你感到不适吗？

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
So, you know Eva... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
所以，你认识伊娃...是吗？

scripts.text: ^660000He sounded weak, as if he did not have enough energy to talk.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他的声音很虚弱，仿佛没有足够的精力说话。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... Ahchoo!

[{0}]
Do you know a man by the name of Oliver Hilpert?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你认识一个叫奥利弗·希尔佩特的男人吗？

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
Oliver? Well, I don't think so.
What does he have to do with anything?
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
奥利弗？我想我不认识。
他和这件事有什么关系？

scripts.text: ^660000You have given him Oliver's novel, <The Crow of the Fate>, explaining strange events that have happened to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000你把奥利弗的小说《命运之鸦》递给他，并解释了最近发生在你身上的奇怪事件。^000000

scripts.text: ^660000He squinted his eyes in curiosity and looked through a few pages of the book quietly. Then he opened his mouth as he handed the book back to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000他好奇地眯起眼睛，安静地翻看了几页书。然后他把书递还给你，张开了嘴。^000000

scripts.text:
[Monsterous Man]
I'm surprised that the story in this book is... It's similar to my life story. Very similar.
scripts.translation:
[怪物般的男子]
我很惊讶这本书里的故事...它很像我的生平。非常像。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
My name is Zid. Tell me what you want from me. I want to know more about this book.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
我叫齐德。告诉我你想要什么。我想知道更多关于这本书的事。

scripts.text: About the Cave Village
scripts.translation: 关于洞穴村

scripts.text: About Himself
scripts.translation: 关于他自己

scripts.text: About Eva
scripts.translation: 关于伊娃

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Did you notice that our villagers look different?
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
你注意到我们的村民看起来和常人不同吗？

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Human curiosity has led to great achievements and contributions, but there is a point where knowledge may be too much to handle.
Everyone in this village is a runaway... We are victims of what happens when people play God, seek out forbidden knowledge, and toy with life.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
人类的好奇心带来了伟大的成就和贡献，但知识有时也会多到让人无法承受。
这个村子里的人都是逃亡者...我们是那些扮演上帝、寻求禁忌知识、玩弄生命的实验的受害者。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
We have no choice but hide here because they are too powerful for us to speak out against... And we know that isn't right.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
我们别无选择，只能躲藏在这里，因为他们太强大，我们无法发声反抗...但我们知道这是不对的。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I was a normal man once, but poverty made me lose my pride, self-esteem, and identity.
I was sick and tired of worrying about food everyday, and I volunteered to be a test subject in some experiment.
I no longer had to worry about starving, but my life as a 'human' ended that day.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
我曾经是个普通人，但贫穷让我失去了尊严、自尊和身份。
我厌倦了每天为食物发愁，于是自愿成为某个实验的受试者。
我不再需要担心挨饿，但在那一天，我作为“人类”的生活结束了。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
At first, Eva and I were the only ones here, but others joined us, and we formed a small settlement.
Now I'm the oldest villager, and feel the heavy responsibility of protecting others.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
起初，这里只有伊娃和我，但后来其他人也加入了我们，我们形成了一个小型定居点。
现在我是村里最年长的村民，感到保护他人的责任重大。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
The laboratory in which Eva and I were being tested was not ordinary.
It was built to test and duplicate God's power of creation.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
伊娃和我被测试的那个实验室并不普通。
它是为了测试和复制上帝创造生命的力量而建造的。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
They failed to achieve their objective, and caused a series of unfortunate events
by trying to manipulate materials that were difficult to even examine.
They believed their research would open a whole new world for mankind...
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
他们未能实现目标，并试图操纵那些连检查都困难的物质，导致了一系列不幸的事件。
他们相信他们的研究将为人类开启一个全新的世界...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva was one of them... Although she wasn't kind, she at least sympathized for me because I sold myself out of poverty.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
伊娃是其中之一...虽然她并不善良，但至少因为她同情我因贫穷而出卖自己。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
She had a man who loved her so much...
His name was Sefakiest, and he always supported her research.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
她有一个深爱她的男人...
他的名字是塞法基斯特，他总是支持她的研究。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
He... Killed himself in despair after Eva was turned into a mutant just like me... She wanted him to use her as his test subject.
No one expected him to end his life so easily when he was the most enthusiastic researcher of all.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
他...在绝望中自杀了，因为伊娃像我一样变成了变异体...她希望他把她当作他的受试者。
没人预料到他会如此轻易地结束自己的生命，尽管他是所有研究员中最热情的那一个。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Then somebody set the laboratory on fire. I assume you've seen that in your dream. The fire completely burned down the building.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
然后有人放火烧了实验室。我想你在梦中见过这一幕。大火将建筑物完全烧毁。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva and I were able to escape before we could be found, and then settled down here. After all, we can't just mingle with ordinary humans.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
伊娃和我在被发现之前逃了出来，然后在这里定居下来。毕竟，我们不能和普通人类混在一起。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva managed to save one of the test subjects which actually grew up into a normal looking human, but he was actually perfect.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
伊娃设法救下了一个受试者，他实际上长成了一个看起来正常的人类，但他其实是完美的。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
That boy ran away when he was about 10. I guess he hit puberty... You know boys and girls at that age.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
那个男孩在10岁左右逃跑了。我想他到了青春期...你知道那个年纪的男孩和女孩。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Eva couldn't forget him. She was waiting for his return inside this dark cave. For a while, he was sending letters without his address, but then they stopped coming. That's when Eva disappeared.
I found ^3131FFa giant black feather^000000 in her room after she left.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
伊娃无法忘记他。她在这个黑暗的洞穴里等待他的归来。有一段时间，他寄来没有地址的信，但后来信就断了。就在那时，伊娃消失了。
她离开后，我在她的房间里发现了一根^3131FF巨大的黑色羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I don't know why, but... I believe Eva no longer exists...
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
我不知道为什么，但...我相信伊娃已经不存在了...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Hmm...
Maybe Oliver is Eva's boy...
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
嗯...
也许奥利弗就是伊娃的那个男孩...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
No, he's too young to be him because it happened a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
不，他太年轻了，不可能是他，因为那已经是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I guess it's just an old memory... Why should I care? Why should anyone?
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
我想那只是陈年旧事...我为什么要在意？谁又会在意呢？

scripts.text: ^660000Zid stopped talking, and then lowered his head. After the pause, he opened his mouth again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000齐德不再说话，低下了头。沉默片刻后，他再次开口。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Now I'm too old to remember even Eva or the boy.
My purpose in life is to protect the other villagers. They have lives ahead of them, living inside this dark cave.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
我现在太老了，连伊娃和那个男孩都记不清了。
我活着的意义就是保护其他村民。他们还有未来，在这黑暗的洞穴里生活着。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
The book was interesting, but I'm sure that guy, Oliver, experienced the same thing that happened to you.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
那本书很有趣，但我确信奥利弗那个家伙，也经历了和你一样的事情。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Even if he has something to do with Eva, it's too late to do anything for her.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
即使他和伊娃有关，现在想为她做点什么也来不及了。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
Think about it: who can save us from this dark cave, even if Eva or that boy is still alive? The answer is nobody.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
想想看：即使伊娃或那个男孩还活着，谁能把我们救离这个黑暗的洞穴？答案是没有人。

scripts.text:
[Zid]
I'm so sorry for not being much help.
You'd better wake up from the dream, and move on with your life.
...Sadly everything is nothing but a dream...
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
很抱歉，我帮不上什么忙。
你最好从梦中醒来，继续你的生活。
...悲伤的是，这一切不过是一场梦...

scripts.text:
[Zid]
If you really feel sorry for us, please do not let others know where we are.
scripts.translation:
[齐德]
如果你真的为我们感到难过，请不要让其他人知道我们在哪里。

scripts.text: ^660000Zid turned his head away from you. You're still not sure if all of this is really happening. It's all so surreal...^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000齐德把头扭向一边。你仍然不确定这一切是否真的发生了。一切都太不真实了...^000000

scripts.text: ^660000Frustrated by the conversation with Zid, you have decided to go back to Morocc and forget everything.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660000对与齐德的对话感到沮丧，你决定回到莫洛克，忘掉这一切。^000000

scripts.text:
Zid seemed to have lost his interest in the book.
You have decided to deliver the book to Benjamin of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
齐德似乎对那本书失去了兴趣。
你决定把那本书交给莫洛克的本杰明。

Don't look at my face...
scripts.translation:

别盯着我的脸看...

咕哝...咕哝...

You want... This?

你想要...这个吗？

Accessory!
My pretty accessory!

scripts.translation:

饰品！
我漂亮的饰品！
哇啊！
我的饰品不见了！

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
No one in this village welcomes you. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
这个村庄里没有人欢迎你。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Cave Settler]
Your eyes are so tempting... I wanna eat them! Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[洞穴定居者]
你的眼睛真诱人...我想吃掉它们！嘿嘿！

Wah!
scripts.translation:

哇！
